features.optics-sfp: SERDES 100/1000Base-X SFP modules, provided by the user (guide page 11) and supplied by Perle, Cisco or other makers of MSA-compliant SFPs (guide page 27: "2 SFP slots supporting SERDES 100/1000Base-X SFP modules")

physical.weight-note: R/U product page: 3.59 kg for the SCG50 dual AC chassis; the page weighs by chassis size and power type, not by model

ac.description: IOLAN SCG50 R, dual AC, with 3 RJ45 RS-232 modules. The six part numbers differ by power cord. In the page's order and labels they are 04033074 USA, 04033071 UK, 04033072 EU, 04033075 South Africa, 04033076 Australia, 04033078 none.

description: Perle IOLAN SCG50 R console server, 1U, with 48 RJ45 RS-232 serial ports in all three of its G16 module bays. It has dual AC power and two network pairs of RJ45 and SFP. The front carries the display, the keypad, the power button, the ready lamp and the card slot. It also has the RJ45 and micro-USB admin ports, two USB 3.0 ports and the reset hole. The rear carries the network pairs at the left, the module bays and the two inlets, each with a rocker switch. Modelled as the dual-AC build with no cellular parts, as the R/U product page lists none.

gaps.note: The 3 fitted modules are drawn as the chassis's own jacks: no document dimensions a G16 module or its face plate, so no module is modelled and no bay is declared where one is fitted (a bay may not overlap a placement). The three bays take the 16-port RS-232 RJ45, USB or multi-protocol RJ45 G16 module in consecutive order from Bay 1 (guide pages 9 and 10); that rule is words only and no tool checks it.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing of a G16 module and a larger straight-on photograph of the rear.

gaps.note: The page 9 photograph shows an orange trim line and diagonal gold stripes at the left of the front; the drawing shows the stripes as hatching. They are not drawn.
gaps.wanted: a larger photograph of the front's left end.

gaps.note: The front ears and the side brackets are drawn from the outline drawing. The guides say only "Rack mount kit", and the page "front and rear mounting hardware included". No document names the kit or shows rear ears.
gaps.wanted: the rack kit's part number and the rear brackets' size.

gaps.note: The plan view shows the two inlets standing 2.7 mm past the rear wall. The view's size is the 262 mm envelope. The renderer paints the chassis colour over the whole view (`render.py` lines 3119 to 3140), so a deeper plan would draw a deeper body. The schema's gap reasons (`device.schema.json` lines 2680 to 2685) have no word for a kit limit, so `needs-drawing` stands. The projection is not drawn. The inlets stay on the rear face.
gaps.wanted: a rear view whose size is not the 262 mm depth, or a dimensioned drawing of the inlets.

gaps.note: The plan view shows each ear flange edge-on, about 2 mm deep, standing 22.1 beyond each end of the body. Unless the body is a sheet shell, the renderer paints the chassis colour over the whole of a view (`render.py` lines 3119 to 3140). A plan 480.2 wide would therefore draw a body that wide. The schema's gap reasons (`device.schema.json` lines 2680 to 2685) have no word for a kit limit, so `needs-drawing` stands. Both plans stay the 436 mm body and the flanges are drawn on the front only.
gaps.wanted: a plan view that may be wider than the body without drawing the body that wide.

gaps.note: The network jacks' lamps, the module lamps and every label under the front connectors are not resolved at the size held. The system-ready lamp is drawn dark.
gaps.wanted: a photograph of each face at a size where the lamps and labels read.

mgmt.mixed: the RJ45 and micro-USB admin ports on the front

name: iolan-scg50-r

colour.note: The median of bare plate in the page 9 photographs is #1d1e20 on the front and #1d1e21 on the rear, a near black. Lettering on the rear is white; the front is lettered in a gold that is not drawn.

ears.note: Estimated from the front view of the same drawing at 6.70 pixels to the millimetre. A flange stands 22.1 past each end of the 436 body and is 43 high, with two slotted holes. The front is therefore 480.2 wide and the chassis stays 436. The drawn front positions are the body's, shifted 22.1 to the right.

front-layout.note: Every front position is read off the front view of the drawing on guide page 35 at 400 dpi (4.44 px/mm). The origin is the body's left edge, then each position is moved right by the ears. Each is checked against the labelled photograph on page 9. The drawing prints no dimension for any feature, so each is good to about 0.5 mm. The drawing also draws a SIM slot, three antenna connectors and a modem jack. The guide says the SIM slot and the modem apply to certain models and the R/U product page lists no cellular or modem feature, so none is drawn here.

network.note: Guide page 11: "two Ethernet combo pairs (RJ45 and SFP) identified as Ethernet 1 and 2"; only one port of each pair is active at a time. The photograph shows an SFP cage above an RJ45 on each pair, numbered 1 and 2.

power.note: Guide page 12: two inlets on the back, each with its own rocker switch. Guide page 27: "100-240 VAC, 50-60 Hz, 1.5 Amps max". The page: "IEC320-C13 to NEMA 5-15P line cord" and four other countries, so the inlet is a C14 (inferred from the cord end; the inlet's own type is not named). The R/U page prints 15.5 W typical and 47-63 Hz; the guide's 50-60 Hz is the one recorded.

rear-layout.note: Every rear position is read off the labelled rear photograph of an SCG50 RRR-LAWM on guide page 9, 1278 px for the 436 mm body (2.93 px/mm across, 2.9 down). The photograph is slightly angled, so each position is estimated to within about 2 mm. The jack pitch reads 14.3 mm and the gap between modules 2.0 mm beyond one pitch; the registry's ganged-jack pitch of 13.97 does not fit the photograph's 24 columns. The two inlets, the rockers, the network cluster and the bays are placed the same way.

serial-ports.note: Product page row: "48 x RS232 RJ45" is the model's own count ("16 x RS232 RJ45 interfaces" for the SCG18 R, per module). Guide page 27: "shielded RJ45 ports". Page 9 prints each column's two numbers as "1^ 2v" above it, odd above even. The ports are RS-232 with software selectable Cisco pinouts (the page).

sides.note: Estimated from the lower view of the drawing on guide page 35 at 600 dpi, 6.71 pixels to the millimetre (the 262 mm label). Each edge is good to about 0.3 mm. Both sides carry the ear bracket, six round holes and six slotted ovals. They also carry two rows of 32 vent slots, two more round holes and two ringed holes. The drawing does not say which side it shows. Its front is at the left, which is the right side on this library's views. So the right side is drawn as the drawing shows it, and the left is its mirror about the depth. The photograph of the unit on guide page 10 shows the same two vent rows in the middle of the side. It also shows a few small holes, in perspective. The photograph shows no bracket fitted, and the drawing draws one on each side in the ear's colour. The guide does not say how the brackets are supplied. The line colour and the hole colour are stand-ins on the body's near black.

size.note: Guide page 35 (and the fixed-model guide, 5500438-10, page 20): the drawing's labels read 436MM, 44MM and 262MM, so the body is 436 wide, 44 high and 262 deep. The product page prints "26.4 x 43.4 x 4.4 (cm)", which differs by 2 mm in depth and width; the drawing is taken because it labels its axes. Height 44 against the 1U rack unit of 44.45 is the drawing's rounding. The drawing's front view is orthographic: 1935 px for the 436 mm body and 194 px for the face, 4.44 px/mm across and 4.44 down.

sources.note: Perle, IOLAN SCG Hardware Installation Guide, Expandable Models (5500427-10, Sept 2021): page 7 (the unit, 1U), page 9 (labelled front and rear photographs of an SCG50 RRU-LAWM, RRR-LAWM and UUU-LAWM), page 10 (modules, the bays), pages 11 to 13 (network ports, inlets, power button), page 27 (specifications) and page 35 (Appendix D, the mechanical drawing). Perle, the IOLAN SCG R/U product page (the IOLAN SCG50 R row: description, part numbers, Specifications tab). No data sheet, CAD model or stencil is held.

top-and-bottom.note: Estimated from the plan view of the same drawing. A line runs the full width 10.8 mm behind the front. The plan is not labelled top or bottom, so both faces carry it. The plan shows the bracket leg edge-on as a line about 2 mm outside each body edge, from 2.2 to 96.9 behind the front. The view is the 436 body, so the leg is drawn as a thin line on each edge, 94.7 long. The plan also shows the ear flange at each end of the front, about 2 mm deep and standing outside the body. Both faces stay the 436 mm body, and the flanges are not drawn on them. The drawing shows no vent or hole on the plan.
